Package com.jwoglom.pumpx2.pump.messages.response.historyLog

Class BolusIobEntryHistoryLog

java.lang.Object
com.jwoglom.pumpx2.pump.messages.response.historyLog.HistoryLog
com.jwoglom.pumpx2.pump.messages.response.historyLog.BolusIobEntryHistoryLog
public class BolusIobEntryHistoryLog extends HistoryLog
Written as a bolus completes, recording the insulin the pump adds to its IOB for that bolus. Tandem publishes no name for opcode 195, so this class name is provisional. Bytes 12-13 were zero in every record observed. See https://github.com/jwoglom/pumpX2/issues/143.

    • getUnknownU8At10

      public int getUnknownU8At10()
      Returns:
      byte 10. 0 when insulin was delivered; 1 in the records for boluses that delivered nothing, which also carry 0xFF in byte 11, 0xFFFFFFFF as the duration and zero floats.

    • getUnknownU8At11

      public int getUnknownU8At11()
      Returns:
      byte 11. Unconfirmed, but it behaves like a slot index into the pump's table of boluses still on board: values stay small, and in about 97% of records it is the lowest index not taken by a bolus completed less than getInsulinDurationMillis() earlier. 0xFF when nothing was delivered.

    • getInsulinDurationMillis

      public long getInsulinDurationMillis()
      Returns:
      the insulin duration applied to this bolus, in milliseconds. It matched the active profile's IDP insulinDuration setting (4, 5, 6 and 8 hours seen). 0xFFFFFFFF when nothing was delivered.

    • getInsulinDelivered

      public float getInsulinDelivered()
      Returns:
      units delivered; equal to BolusCompletedHistoryLog.getInsulinDelivered() bit for bit

    • getMudaliarIob

      public float getMudaliarIob()
      Returns:
      Mudaliar IOB in units after adding this bolus; equal to IobSnapshotPostBolusHistoryLog.getMudaliarIob() bit for bit. This is the pump's displayed IOB only when it displays the Mudaliar model (selectedIob 0).
